item.title: Gyaru Bitch na Do S Osananajimi ni Choukyou Sarete Dorei ni Natta Boku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: S Underground
  • 発売日: 2013-12-20
  • スコア: 5.220000000000001/10 (38 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ギャルビッチなドS幼馴染みに調教されて奴隷になったボク
  • 英語名: Gyaru Bitch na Do S Osananajimi ni Choukyou Sarete Dorei ni Natta Boku

あらすじ

My name is Kouji Onoda.

When I was little Alice Aikawa bullied me. My life was a nightmare.

Something happened with her parents, work or something, and she moved away.

Everything was better after that. I studied more, got into sports, made friends. I even got on the student council.

item.title: Akuochi Valkyria Teikoku ~Odin-sama, Penis Band no Ojikan Desu wa yo♪~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: S Underground
  • 発売日: 2013-10-25
  • スコア: 5.46/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 悪堕ちヴァルキュリア帝国 ～オーディン様、ペニスバンドのお時間ですわよ♪～
  • 英語名: Akuochi Valkyria Teikoku Odin-sama, Penis Band no Ojikan Desu wa yo♪

别名

  • Fallen Angel Valkyrie‛＼s Sadistic Paradise

あらすじ

Asgard, realm of Gods, has been taken by the Orcish Insurgence, and protagonist Odin is their prisoner of war.

He commands his loyal goddesses to defend him, so why have they turned on him like this?

Darkness has corrupted the hearts of beautiful Valkyria, Freyja and Skuld. The Insurgence will use Odin’s own women to break him down!
